materiality.rationale: The W33 paper reports a controlled one-task comparison across seven agent scaffoldings and five language models, with repository-state checks and large scaffolding-dependent cost variation; it matters because orchestration choices can change agent outcomes and cost, within the paper's one-task scope.

profile_annotations.why_this_issue: This issue needs the result because it separates agent-system scaffolding effects from model identity: MCP versus CLI and surrounding scaffolding are relevant to how coding-agent performance and cost should be interpreted.
